desc: Implement input parsing and adjacency-list construction for all M weighted undirected XOR constraints.
Traverse each connected component iteratively to compute XOR potentials from a root and detect contradictions, including self-loops and parallel edges.
If any contradiction is found, output -1 and terminate.
For each consistent component, count per-bit ones among base values and choose the offset bit that minimizes the component sum.
Construct and print the final sequence A using the chosen offsets and stored potentials.
Verify the implementation against the provided sample tests.
